ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a “schematic terrain profile from Xining to Lhasa”, and the vertical axis is labeled elevation (meters). One end of the profile is labeled Lhasa, and the other end is labeled Xining; in the middle, rivers such as the Nujiang River, Lancang River, Yangtze River, and Yellow River appear in sequence, as well as undulating plateau terrain. Reasoning: In the summer half-year, precipitation on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is mainly affected by water vapor transported by the monsoon. The Lhasa side is relatively closer to the direction from which summer monsoon water vapor enters the plateau, while Xining is located in the northeastern part of the plateau and deeper inland; by the time water vapor transport reaches it, it has already decreased noticeably. Therefore, compared with Lhasa, Xining obtains less water vapor in the summer half-year and has less precipitation.

raw_record.question_text:

<image1>

In the summer half-year, compared with Lhasa, what characteristics does Xining's precipitation have?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：剖面图显示拉萨在剖面一端，西宁在另一端，中间隔着多条大江和高原地形。再结合题干要求比较夏半年降水。根据夏半年水汽主要受季风输送、离水汽源越远且越深入高原东北部水汽越少的规律，判断西宁比拉萨得到的夏季水汽少，因此西宁降水较少。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中为“西宁至拉萨一线地形剖面示意图”，纵轴标注海拔（米）。剖面一端标有拉萨，另一端标有西宁，中间依次出现怒江、澜沧江、长江、黄河等河流及起伏的高原地形。推理：夏半年青藏高原的降水主要受季风输送水汽影响。拉萨一侧相对更靠近夏季风水汽进入高原的方向，而西宁位于高原东北部、更深入内陆，水汽输送到达时已明显减少。因此与拉萨相比，西宁夏半年获得的水汽少，降水较少。
